annotations.title: Pre-check ad copy for policy risk

description: Scan ad copy for the two patterns behind most rejections: a business category the platform prohibits or gates behind certification, and a claim the platform treats as unverifiable. Returns each match with the governing policy page. This is a pattern pre-check, not an approval; only the platform's review decides whether an ad runs.

landing_url.description: Optional landing page URL, checked alongside the copy.

platform.description: Ad platform. Known keys: apple, google, linkedin, meta, microsoft, reddit, telegram, tiktok.

vertical.description: Optional business category, for example 'dental clinic'.

name: check_ad_policy_preflight
